title: ruta propinqua
intro: Ruta propinqua, commonly known as Wild Rue or Mexican Rue, is a flowering plant that belongs to the Rutaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Ruta propinqua include its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. Research has identified the presence of rutaecarpine, a key bioactive compound responsible for the plant's medicinal properties.
